notes:
2026-09-30
 Accuracy
- Walking GPS at the default 1-second interval is credited again. The old 4 m noise floor needed a 14 km/h hop; it now scales with the interval (1 m at 1 s, 4 m at 4 s).
- Existing 0 km walks that still have a GPS track are repaired on the phone from those points. Nothing is deleted, and a row that already has distance is never shrunk. The pass walks by id in the background of one launch (not one page per cold start), so a short unrepairable track cannot stall the app.
- Parked vehicle GPS (crawl speed, tiny hops) is not journey distance.
- Resting heart rate uses yesterday when today is missing, and never compares a day to itself. Non-numbers and ≤20 bpm are ignored.
